summary: GoatCounter is an open-source web analytics platform designed to measure traffic without collecting personal data or setting tracking cookies. It processes visitor metrics while maintaining user privacy, operating under the EUPL-1.2 licence. Written in Go, the application provides a straightforward interface for reviewing page views and referral sources.
goodFor: Self-hosters who want lightweight, privacy-focused website statistics without the heavy resource footprint or tracking concerns of commercial analytics suites.
watchOut: The project maintains a moderate maintenance rhythm, and it may lack the advanced funnel analysis or deep segmentation found in larger enterprise alternatives.
deployNotes: As a Go binary, it typically compiles into a single executable and requires a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination, alongside persistent storage for its database.
